releaseNotes:
- Gateway policy moves after sign-in keep you signed in. If the session is missing, the app returns to the full-screen sign-in page instead of staying inside the editor unsigned in.
- The account page can change your password in a dialog.
- First-time item image orders are no longer rejected for missing optional image fields.
- Outfit-anchor image orders no longer send the same character portrait to the model twice.
- Character portrait identity is restored from the resource inventory, so outfit anchors are no longer rejected for a missing portrait path.
- Unregistered items are blocked before image generation, and publish failures keep the real error.
- After script reviews pass, the skills now remind you to add music and sfx tags to formal scripts before visual and audio production.
- Plan review and pre-audition guidance now remind you to check voice gender and age range, instead of filling them in by role function.
releaseNotesZh:
- 登录后按账号策略切换网关时会保留登录状态；会话失效时回到全屏登录页，不再停在编辑器里显示未登录。
- 账号页支持在对话框中修改密码。
- 道具首次出图不再因缺少图片字段被整单拒收。
- 服装锚点出图不再把同一角色肖像重复送给模型。
- 按资源清单恢复角色头像身份后，换装锚点不再因缺少头像路径被拒。
- 未登记的道具会在出图前被拦截，发布失败也会保留真实原因。
- 剧本评审通过后，会提示先在正式剧本里补齐配乐和音效标签，再进入视觉和音频制作。
- 规划评审和试听前会提示核对配音性别和年龄段，避免按角色功能临时填写。
